sloka: यदि दग्धा त्वियं लङ्का नूनमार्यापि जानकी ।दग्धा तेन मया भर्तुर्हतं कार्यमजानता ।। 5.55.9 ।।।।
transliteration: yadi dagdhā tviyaṁ laṅkā nūnamāryāpi jānakī ।dagdhā tena mayā bharturhataṁ kāryamajānatā ।। 5.55.9 ।।।।

translations.english: 'My very mission is foiled. Sita has not been protected by me for no part of Lanka has escaped unburnt.
